text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only a little of the summer training camp 
remained. Just as I was pondering how 
Sounds of Earth could become even 
stronger—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is...? A transcendentally 
virtuosic etude...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
" 'A training course located in the 
mountain behind us. It is rugged and 
difficult to traverse, but the results are 
substantial'—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: This is it!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I must consult my Trainer affrettando!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The Ultra-Bizarre Marco Polo, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Based on a secret training book Sounds of 
Earth found at the training camp, we 
arrived at a challenging training course.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"So this is the prelude... I see. It 
certainly doesn't look like it'll be a 
walk in the park."
choice_data_list:
That's precisely why we can expect great 
results.

That's precisely why we can expect great 
results.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! We must surpass the generation 
before us and perform a magnificent 
musica.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Let us overcome our trials and play an 
even more exquisite melodia!"

Outta the way, outta the way, outta the 
wayyy! Make way for the legendary tour 
guide~~!!
choice_data_list: Is that voice... !?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: G-Golshi-san!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Coming all the way here... Ah! Having 
achieved such a brilliant record on the 
turf, you're aiming for even greater 
heights, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I don't give a crap about that! It's super 
bizarre Marco Polo... meaning there's 
treasure, right? Then that treasure's 
mine!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait, my little treasure! 
Golshi-sama's gonna make a specimen out of 
ya~!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
As expected of one who proudly ruled the 
older generation... What a vivace pace!
choice_data_list: I can't afford to fall behind either!
We can't afford to fall behind either!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course! I shall surpass it... that 
shining luce!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Golshi-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wha, you're here already!? I bet you dry 
your laundry indoors, don't you!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Then I'm a psychic ojou-sama!
choice_data_list: Huh... Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Gold Ship diverged from the 
route in the materials and began climbing 
the steep slope...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Volti subito! Let's hurry and catch up!
choice_data_list:
Let's power our way up the slope with 
brute force!
We should be patient and take the detour.
We should be patient and take the detour.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Volti subito! Let's hurry and catch up!
choice_data_list:
Let's power our way up the slope with 
brute force!
We should be patient and take the detour.
We should be patient and take the detour.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'll charge right up dinamico!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth is going to sprint up with 
everything she's got. If so, I'll only get 
in the way if I try to follow her—
choice_data_list:
...Go on ahead. I'll be waiting on the way 
back.

...Go on ahead. I'll wait for you on the 
way back.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I see... You're right. It's farewell for 
now. Let's meet again with smiles on our 
faces—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ciao!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...! It seems you... are 
struggling too...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*gasp* *pant*... Not bad, eh...! But 
Golshi-chan still has a secret ace up her 
sleeve!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Four-wheel drive mode, ON! Reverse 
thruster boost, GOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Going at such a pace on bad 
ground! ...Ugh, I can barely catch my 
breath over here...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Musica! Grant me strength! An 
endless resonance!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Now, take your stance! Quickly, quickly! 
Matador, stay focused! Matador!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
!? It's welling up from within... This is 
the Toreador Song!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Spiritoso, like a matador! 
Harbor it in your heart... a brave, 
valiant soul!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! Not to Gold Ship-san, and 
not to the trials ahead!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "‘Love...! Love...! Love...!’"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ♪ "Toreador, love awaits thee!" ♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“Indeed. Fatigued as we are, ad-libbing is 
risky. Let us proceed along the flat path 
affrettando!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth is going to run all-out. 
If so, I'll only get in the way if I try 
to follow her—
choice_data_list:
...Go on ahead. I'll be waiting on the way 
back.

...Go on ahead. I'll wait for you on the 
way back.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie, Trainer. To be honest, it looks 
like I won't have the leeway to worry 
about you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Show me that smile again later. My amore—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ciao!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Guh... *pant* *pant* *pant* *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can't see what's ahead! Where's the goal 
line?! Isn't there any sound to give me a 
clue...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dead silence...)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Utterly calmato... Is this forest 
completely ruled by silence...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ba-bump... ba-bump...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The heartbeat of the forest... No, that's 
not it! This is my own heart, racing con 
brio!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, what on earth am I doing? Even 
without relying on sound, the sound is 
still there!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The suonare of my soul screams at me to 
run! I have only to follow that sound!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Here I go! My beloved Ritmo, whom I've 
always believed in!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, haa... Got you! I won't let 
you get away this time, amore!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I gotta hand it to ya. Nobody's pushed me 
this far since Cleopatra.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's settle this once and for all! 
I'm not giving up the treasure!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: FINAAALEEEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth and Gold Ship dashed off 
toward the cape.

text_block_list.name: Earth & Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'm gonna loooose--!! I won't 
let myself loooose--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And finally, the race was settled. The 
winner was—Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back. The three of us strolled 
along the coast, and the training camp 
lodge finally came into view.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaahooo! This is the greatest treasure 
ever! I'm gonna shower you with so much 
love, my giant conch shell-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think there really was treasure 
here. What a bellissima conch shell.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right? Once a baby conch is born, I'll 
give it to you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright, see ya laaaater~!
choice_data_list:
Haha... Looks like you've still got plenty 
left in the tank

Haha... Looks like you've still got plenty 
left in the tank, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A steady tempo, a deep and rich resonance. 
Golshi-san truly was a great musicista...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me. You believed in me and 
waited... I suppose our fun salute will 
have to wait."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the gap in ability and confirming 
where one stands is also vital. For her, 
today's defeat carries immense 
significance.
choice_data_list:
You've taken a step closer to becoming a 
great musician too.

You've taken a step closer to becoming a 
great musician, too.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... We may have lost, but the trial 
was surpassed. The maturity of our 
strumento should have deepened.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"And 'Musica was not built in a day'— our 
concerto with the musical masters 
continues!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Continue to bestow upon me your 
amoreâyour demanding, yet love-filled 
practica!
choice_data_list: Yeah, leave it to me!
Yeah, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tightened my resolve even further so 
that Sounds of Earth could keep growing!
